blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected the current five views and six poses after V122. The front jacket covers the bust in the neutral view, but the front and three-quarter views still show uneven dark/body-colored intrusions along the bust-side transition, and both side views retain pinched, faceted torso transitions. The local front-only refinement reduced measured inward surface offsets, but the rendered fit remains visibly broken.
The current back render still has broad faceted/folded shading across the posterior shoulder and upper back.
The outfit remains almost entirely white with a narrow lilac diagonal chest strip and sparse details; metallic lamé response and fencing-practice styling are not visually legible.

Current sit and crouch renders show skirt/shorts lift and thigh intersections; prone shows a broad disk-like skirt flare. Final fit, deform weights, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, and release packaging remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
